rules: Exactly these five authorities are published.
Do not collapse them into SOURCE_SHA or RELEASE_CANDIDATE_SHA.
APP_RUNTIME_SOURCE_SHA stays the historical runner source until RC2.2B creates a new one.
BUILD_DEFINITION_SHA is the commit that introduces the canonical builder files.
DEPLOYMENT_BUNDLE_SHA is the commit that introduces the RC2.2A dossier.
A commit cannot store its own id. The dossier records the resolved ids after those commits exist.
